Description: We are a community acupuncture clinic. Before SIP orders, we were located at 1834 University Ave, giving over 500 acupuncture treatments per week. After SIP orders, we were unable to reopen at the same capacity and could no longer afford that space. We have moved to 1700 Shattuck Ave where we are subletting and sharing the Yoga Kula space. We have three private acupuncture rooms, and a community room where we can treat 1-3 patients an hour.
